subject: european bison
title: Wolves Grabbed a Bison Calf. Then the Whole Herd Came Back

scenes.text: Wolves grabbed a newborn bison calf. Then the herd turned around.
A camera trap in Poland's Bialowieza Forest caught it in September 2025.
The wolves bit the calf's neck and tried to drag it away.
Two bison cows charged and drove them off. The wolves came back and seized it again.
This time the entire herd closed in around the calf.
It's the first time wolves were filmed hunting European bison. And no kill was ever caught on camera.

description:
Camera traps in Poland's Bialowieza Forest filmed wolves attacking a newborn European bison calf on 15 September 2025, the first footage of wolves hunting this species.
Wolves bit the calf's neck and tried to drag it off; two cows drove them away, and when the wolves returned, the whole herd defended it (Ecology and Evolution, 2026). No kill was recorded.
Who wins this fight more often, the pack or the herd?
first_comment: Over 870 bison live on the Polish side of this forest. Would you bet on the wolves or the herd?
